lakes.name: Bellandur Lake
lakes.area_basis: Legal lake extent from revenue records (RTC), as reported by IISc. Upper bound of the open-water surface; the current water spread is smaller (KTCDA 2026 compliance report: 794 acres 26 guntas of water-spread area).
lakes.kc_source: FAO-56 Table 12: Open Water, < 2 m depth or in subhumid climates or tropics, Kc 1.05
lakes.source: Ramachandra T.V. et al. (2017) Bellandur and Varthur Lakes Rejuvenation Blueprint, ENVIS Technical Report 116 / Sahyadri Conservation Series 34, EWRG, CES, IISc, sec. 2.1.1

lakes.name: Varthur Lake
lakes.area_basis: Lake extent from revenue records, as reported by IISc. Upper bound of the open-water surface (another IISc study gives a 220 ha water spread; an older morphometric survey gives 147.8 ha).
lakes.kc_source: FAO-56 Table 12: Open Water, < 2 m depth or in subhumid climates or tropics, Kc 1.05
lakes.source: Ramachandra T.V. et al. (2017) Bellandur and Varthur Lakes Rejuvenation Blueprint, ENVIS Technical Report 116 / Sahyadri Conservation Series 34, EWRG, CES, IISc, sec. 2.1.2

lakes.name: KRS reservoir (Krishna Raja Sagara)
lakes.area_text: 130 km2 water-spread area at full reservoir level (124.8 ft)
lakes.area_basis: Water spread at FULL reservoir level. In dry months the reservoir is lower, so this is an upper bound.
lakes.kc_source: FAO-56 Table 12: Open Water, < 2 m depth or in subhumid climates or tropics, Kc 1.05
lakes.source: Assessment of sedimentation in Krishnaraja Sagar reservoir of Karnataka, India using remote sensing, International Research Journal of Engineering and Technology (IRJET) Vol 6 Issue 9 (2019), study area section
